gen-dafont-alien-encounters-gf-pridi: Otherworldly lettering with big gaps between pairs sits up top. Pridi, a classic serif, answers with small letters that stand almost capital-sized, and Alien Encounters earns its keep when it runs big and brief.
gen-dafont-alien-encounters-gf-scope-one: Scope One reads like a traditional text serif, its counters spilling open and its ascenders staying stubby beside a big x-height. Scope One is the grounded half here, while Alien Encounters supplies the technological, high-x-height strangeness above it.
gen-dafont-alien-encounters-gf-slabo-13p: Alien Encounters spaces its letter pairs far apart and stands tall, a technological display face with an otherworldly streak. Slabo 13px follows in a bookish serif with large open counters, so a long passage would read slowly and with dignity.
gen-dafont-alien-encounters-gf-suwannaph: Suwannaphum reads dignified and editorial, with a c as open as a bent paperclip and a high, squared-off x-height. Alien Encounters is best at stretching out otherworldly shapes with wide gaps, while Suwannaphum is best at holding a serif line steady and upright.
gen-dafont-alien-encounters-instrument-s: Instrument Sans reads clean and modern, its c ends pointing apart like open pincers and its strokes never varying. And Alien Encounters gives the pair its strongest quality, a sharp contrast between a display heading's low-slung gaps and a body that never thins at the shoulders.
gen-dafont-alien-encounters-inter: Inter reads smooth and tube-like, with counters that breathe. Alien Encounters does its best work as an otherworldly heading with wide gaps between letters, while Inter handles the sans-serif job of constant, unshaded strokes across a tall lowercase.
gen-dafont-alien-encounters-mulish: Alien Encounters brings an otherworldly, technological heading with big gaps between its letter pairs and a high x-height, over a modern body. Mulish keeps its sans-serif strokes like twine pressed flat.
gen-dafont-alien-encounters-roboto-slab: Spacey, technological shapes meet a structured slab. Alien Encounters earns its keep when it runs big and short, and Roboto Slab, a precise slab-serif with open throats, fills in the line below.
gen-dafont-alien-encounters-rubik: Rubik brings a clean, soft look, with lowercase letters that stand big next to its capitals. And Alien Encounters supplies the otherworldly heading, while the body's size can stay generous so its open round letters keep reading clearly.
gen-dafont-amadeus-fs-supreme: Wide, bold, unmistakably loud: Amadeus stretches its words across the line with no tilt in its curves. But Supreme, a crisp plain sans, is better at holding a heavy-looking strip of text with its letters kept open.
